dedupe_keys.name: life programme public project database cinea

description: The LIFE Public Database is the European Commission's searchable register of projects funded by the LIFE programme for the environment and climate action, together with their documents such as reports and layman's summaries. CINEA, the European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency, runs it; the application was at release 3.36 in July 2026. Users can run a unified search over projects and documents, or advanced searches of each, with keyword variants and phrase matching, and export the results, and pages list the latest updated projects and documents. Coverage is LIFE projects across EU member states, many of them on nature-based solutions, green infrastructure, river and wetland restoration and climate adaptation. Format and access: a public web database with exports; no login is needed to search. Licence: not stated on the pages read; free. Caveats: the about page returned an error when read, and project descriptions are self-reported by beneficiaries. It helps find evidence and case studies for green-blue infrastructure and adaptation planning. Related catalogue records are the Lisbon LIFE LUNGS and Guadeloupe LIFE Adapt'Island case studies, both LIFE projects.
